description: Find animated SVG illustrations from Illos.dev for a website or app. Use it first, when a hero, feature section, empty state, docs page, onboarding or status screen needs a picture instead of stock art, an emoji or an empty space; describe what the section explains, not keywords. Each match gives its id, theme, size, whether it is free, its page and, for free ones, a one-line install command. Next, call get_illustration with an id to add it; if you already have an id, call get_illustration directly. If the site has no Illos theme yet, call list_themes first.

free_only.description: Only illustrations that are free with no account.

need.description: What the picture is for, in plain words: "empty state for notifications", "hero for a payments API", "docs page about webhooks".

name: find_illustrations
title: Find illustrations
